h1: Custom 2X Large Workwear for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 2X large workwear for your team. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing on hi-vis vests, jackets, and more.
introHtml: When you need workwear that fits your crew properly, 2X large sizing ensures comfort and mobility on the job. From hi-vis safety vests to durable Carhartt® duck vests, our selection covers construction sites, warehouses, and outdoor teams. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that lasts. Bulk orders ship fast across the US.
